title: He was born in India. In October 2026, he was elected mayor of a Canadian mountain town.

sources.text: My East Kootenay Now - Ramadass elected as Fernie's mayor
Deccan Chronicle - India-born Harshan Ramadass wins Fernie mayoral race

caption:
He was born in India. In October 2026, he was elected mayor of a Canadian mountain town.

He won with 54.5% of the vote - 1,524 votes to fellow councillor Kyle Hamilton's 1,194 - in BC's 2026 municipal elections, after previously serving as a Fernie city councillor.

From city councillor to mayor, his path shows how deeply Indian-origin leaders are now embedded in municipal government in small-town Canada, not just its major cities.

Ramadass's win is a reminder that Indian-origin political representation abroad now reaches well beyond national capitals and major metros.
